[h1]Updates / fixed :[/h1]

- Rework and render the start of the videos with Nikki & Emmy.

- Add extra H-scene with training sport with Stella.

- Add option for buy x5 pills with the doctor.

- Charism : Do sport give you 5/5 at one time.


[h1][b]helpful hints[/b][/h1]

- Remember to visit your apartment regularly to check for mail, deliveries, or unexpected guests.

- Talk to the doctor when you're alone to unlock a new menu option.

- Talk to the vendor to unlock need scenes.

- You can call Tracy and see her at the casino and the shop. (You need to see her first at the photo studio with Nikki.)
